entities.name: PMID:10751853
observations: Human study of 15 interstitial cystitis patients and 13 controls undergoing bladder hydrodistension at 80 cm water three times; urine was collected before, 2–4 hours after, and 2 weeks after distension.
In interstitial cystitis, hydrodistension increased urinary HB-EGF toward control values and decreased urinary antiproliferative factor activity; effects persisted through 2 weeks.

Pre-distension IC-versus-control HB-EGF difference was significant (P=0.003), but not at 2 weeks (P=0.67). APF remained different from controls at 2 weeks (P=0.04 versus P=0.0000004 before distension).

entities.name: Interstitial cystitis
observations: Patients with interstitial cystitis showed increased urinary HB-EGF and decreased urinary APF activity after bladder hydrodistension in PMID:10751853.

entities.name: HB-EGF
observations: Bladder hydrodistension increased urinary HB-EGF in interstitial cystitis patients toward control levels; the IC-control difference was no longer significant at 2 weeks (P=0.67).
HB-EGF denotes heparin-binding epidermal growth factor.

entities.name: APF activity reduction
observations: Urinary antiproliferative factor activity decreased significantly after hydrodistension in interstitial cystitis patients, although it remained different from controls at 2 weeks (P=0.04).
